title: Core invariants
description: Universal requirements that apply to every task regardless of domain or risk level. See PRD Phase 7, Layer 1.

rules.title: Preserve user intent
rules.purpose: Prevent the executor from substituting its own goal for the user's.
rules.requirement: The deliverable must address brief.goal as stated, or explicitly flag and justify any deviation before proceeding.
rules.evidence_requirement: A reviewer can trace each deliverable back to brief.goal or an explicitly logged, justified deviation.

rules.title: Separate facts from assumptions
rules.purpose: Prevent silently-assumed context from being reported as if it were given.
rules.requirement: Every assumption made about missing information must be recorded in scope.assumptions rather than asserted as fact.
rules.evidence_requirement: scope.assumptions lists anything the executor inferred rather than was told.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 7, Layer 1: 'Separate facts from assumptions'.

rules.title: Do not claim unperformed work
rules.purpose: Prevent reporting verification, execution, or research that did not actually happen.
rules.requirement: Every entry in status.verified_facts must correspond to something actually executed or inspected, labeled with an honest evidence_label (never a stronger label than the evidence supports).
rules.evidence_requirement: Each verified fact cites what was run or read; fabricated citations or invented results are treated as a hard-constraint violation, not a scoring deduction.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 1 (fabricated sources) and 'Final report' evidence-labeling requirement.

rules.title: Respect authorization boundaries
rules.purpose: Prevent inferred or assumed authorization for actions the user never granted.
rules.scope: All tasks with any risk_overlays beyond 'informational'.
rules.requirement: No action outside routing.authorization.granted_permissions may be taken, and every action in routing.authorization.requires_confirmation_for must be confirmed with the user before execution, regardless of budget pressure.
rules.evidence_requirement: A log or transcript entry showing confirmation was obtained before each such action.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 12/13: authorization boundaries and confused-deputy prevention.

rules.title: Protect secrets and private data
rules.purpose: Prevent leaking credentials or personal data into artifacts, logs, or reports.
rules.requirement: No secret, credential, API key, or personal data beyond what the task explicitly requires may appear in exported artifacts, logs, or error messages.
rules.evidence_requirement: A secret-scan of produced artifacts reports no matches.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 13/14: secret leakage threat and privacy requirements.

rules.title: Use evidence appropriate to the claim
rules.purpose: Prevent a strong claim (e.g. 'tests pass') from resting on weak evidence (e.g. 'looks right').
rules.requirement: Each acceptance criterion's evidence_required must match its verification_method in strength (e.g. automated_test claims are backed by actual command output, not by inspection alone).
rules.evidence_requirement: Reviewer confirms the evidence type matches the declared verification method.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 5: evidence_quality dimension; Phase 1: evidence hierarchy.

rules.title: Define completion before execution
rules.purpose: Prevent moving goalposts by deciding acceptance criteria only after seeing the result.
rules.requirement: acceptance.criteria must be non-empty before execution begins, unless the task is pure open-ended exploration explicitly marked as such in scope.non_goals.
rules.evidence_requirement: The contract's acceptance.criteria predates the first execution iteration.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 4/9: acceptance criteria and Definition of Done grounding.

rules.title: Report limitations and uncertainty
rules.purpose: Prevent a confident-sounding report from hiding what is actually unknown or unverified.
rules.requirement: status.remaining_uncertainty and status.residual_risks must be populated whenever either: completion_status is 'partial' or 'blocked' (these states are inherently uncertain by definition); or completion_status is 'complete' and status.unverified_claims is non-empty (a 'complete' report may still carry unverified claims, but may not stay silent about them). Clarified in 0.1.1: the 'with any unverified_claims present' condition applies only to the 'complete' case -- 'partial'/'blocked' always require this regardless of unverified_claims.
rules.evidence_requirement: The final report enumerates open uncertainty rather than implying none exists.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD 'Final report' section and Phase 6 budget-expiration reporting.

rules.title: Budget expiry may never be reported as full completion
rules.purpose: Prevent a task that ran out of budget from silently skipping verification and calling itself done.
rules.requirement: status.completion_status must be 'partial' or 'blocked', never 'complete', and status.omitted_work must describe what was cut.
rules.evidence_requirement: Mechanically checked by groundspec audit/evaluate: see groundspec.budget.model.forbid_silent_skip_on_expiry.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 6: 'Never skip required verification silently' / 'Return incomplete rather than pretending completion.'
